templates.headline: NVIDIA smashes earnings expectations
templates.explanation: Profits came in far above forecasts, so investors pay more for each share.

templates.headline: Apple faces probe over app store fees
templates.explanation: Regulators may force lower fees, which would cut one of Apple's most profitable businesses.

templates.headline: Coca-Cola recalls drinks in three countries
templates.explanation: Recalls cost money and can dent a brand's reputation.

templates.headline: Exxon hit with record fine over oil spill
templates.explanation: A large fine comes straight out of profits; only Exxon is affected.

templates.headline: Walmart sales not as bad as feared
templates.explanation: Investors expected a weak quarter; 'less bad than expected' is good news for the price.

templates.headline: Chip export curbs hit tech stocks
templates.explanation: Tech companies depend on chip sales abroad; the whole sector reprices.

templates.headline: AI spending boom lifts tech shares
templates.explanation: Businesses are buying more computing power, which helps every tech company.

templates.headline: Record highs fail to hold as chip rally fizzles
templates.explanation: Tech had run up fast; buyers stepped back and prices fell from their peak.

templates.headline: OPEC cuts output, oil prices jump
templates.explanation: Less oil supply means higher oil prices, so oil companies earn more.

templates.headline: Oil glut fears ease as demand recovers
templates.explanation: Worries about too much oil faded; stronger demand supports oil company profits.

templates.headline: Oil prices slump on weak demand
templates.explanation: Cheaper oil means lower revenue for every oil producer.

templates.headline: Shoppers splurge as retail sales surge
templates.explanation: People are spending more, which lifts companies that sell everyday goods.

templates.headline: Consumer spending slows as prices bite
templates.explanation: When households cut back, consumer companies sell less.

templates.headline: Central bank surprises with rate cut
templates.explanation: Cheaper borrowing helps almost every company, so the whole market rises.

templates.headline: Recession fears rattle markets
templates.explanation: A slowing economy would hurt most companies at once — diversification can't avoid this part.

templates.headline: Strong jobs report boosts confidence
templates.explanation: More people working means more spending across the whole economy.

templates.headline: NVIDIA warns of slowing chip orders
templates.explanation: Customers are buying fewer chips than hoped, so future profits look smaller than investors priced in.

templates.headline: Apple's new iPhone sells out in hours
templates.explanation: Strong demand means more sales and profit this year.

templates.headline: Coca-Cola raises its dividend again
templates.explanation: A bigger cash payout each year signals confidence and attracts income investors.

templates.headline: Exxon strikes a giant new oil field
templates.explanation: Years of extra oil to sell means more future profit.

templates.headline: Walmart warns profits will shrink
templates.explanation: The company itself expects to earn less, and investors trust that warning.

templates.headline: Microsoft cloud sales beat forecasts
templates.explanation: Azure grew faster than expected, and cloud is Microsoft's growth engine.

templates.headline: Microsoft hit by global cloud outage
templates.explanation: Customers lost service for hours; some may move to rivals and refunds cost money.

templates.headline: Amazon's holiday sales smash records
templates.explanation: The busiest shopping season went better than anyone forecast.

templates.headline: Regulators sue Amazon over unfair pricing
templates.explanation: A long court fight could force changes to how Amazon runs its store.

templates.headline: JPMorgan profits jump on higher interest income
templates.explanation: Banks earn more on loans when interest rates are higher.

templates.headline: JPMorgan sets aside billions for bad loans
templates.explanation: The bank expects some borrowers to stop paying, which eats into profit.

templates.headline: Pfizer's new drug passes final trial
templates.explanation: A successful trial means a new medicine to sell for years.

templates.headline: Pfizer drug trial fails, shares tumble
templates.explanation: Years of research money are lost and a hoped-for product won't reach the market.

templates.headline: Johnson & Johnson wins approval for cancer drug
templates.explanation: Regulators allowed a new product onto the market.

templates.headline: Johnson & Johnson faces lawsuit over talc
templates.explanation: Legal costs and possible damages could be large.

templates.headline: Tech stocks rally as chip shortage ends
templates.explanation: Factories can build more devices again, so tech companies can sell more.

templates.headline: Electric car boom dents oil demand
templates.explanation: Every electric car means less petrol sold, a long-term threat to oil companies.

templates.headline: Banks rally as loan demand surges
templates.explanation: More people and firms borrowing means more interest income for banks.

templates.headline: Bank failure sparks fears across the finance sector
templates.explanation: When one bank collapses, investors worry about which one is next.

templates.headline: Bank stress fears fade as deposits return
templates.explanation: Savers are putting money back into banks, so the panic is calming down.

templates.headline: Healthcare stocks climb on ageing-population demand
templates.explanation: Older populations need more medicine, a steady long-term tailwind.

templates.headline: Government plans drug price caps
templates.explanation: Lower prices for medicines mean lower profits for drug makers.

templates.headline: Inflation surprise sparks fears of rate hikes
templates.explanation: Higher interest rates make borrowing dearer and savings accounts more attractive than shares.

templates.headline: Markets shrug off weak data as earnings hold up
templates.explanation: Company profits matter more to investors than one gloomy statistic.

templates.headline: Trade war fears hit global markets
templates.explanation: New tariffs make imports dearer and can slow the whole economy.

templates.headline: Stimulus package sends stocks soaring
templates.explanation: Government spending puts money in people's pockets, which boosts company sales.

templates.headline: Visa payment volumes hit a new record
templates.explanation: More card payments mean more fees for Visa.

templates.headline: Visa fined for blocking rival payment apps
templates.explanation: A fine costs money once, but forced changes could cut future fees.

templates.headline: Chevron refinery fire halts production
templates.explanation: No production means nothing to sell until repairs are done.

templates.headline: Flash crash wipes out a week of gains
templates.explanation: Computer trading and panic fed on each other; nothing about the companies changed, but prices fell anyway.

templates.headline: Online ad spending rebounds strongly
templates.explanation: Advertisers are spending again, and ads pay for search, social media and TV.

templates.headline: Streaming price war squeezes media profits
templates.explanation: Services cut prices to win subscribers, so every media company earns less per viewer.

templates.headline: Phone networks win new airwaves at auction
templates.explanation: More airwaves mean faster networks and more customers for phone companies.

templates.headline: New privacy law limits targeted ads
templates.explanation: Ads that can't be targeted are worth less, which hurts every ad-funded company.

templates.headline: Congress passes huge infrastructure bill
templates.explanation: Billions for roads, bridges and railways means years of orders for industrial companies.

templates.headline: Factory orders slump for a third month
templates.explanation: Fewer orders today means less work and lower profits for machine makers tomorrow.

templates.headline: Airlines order record number of new jets
templates.explanation: Jet and engine makers get paid for years, and engines need servicing for decades.

templates.headline: Port strike snarls global shipping
templates.explanation: Stuck containers delay deliveries and raise costs for transport and factory companies.

templates.headline: Copper prices spike on China building boom
templates.explanation: Miners sell copper at the market price, so a higher price goes straight to profit.

templates.headline: Metal prices sink as Chinese demand dries up
templates.explanation: China buys about half the world's metals; when it stops building, prices fall.

templates.headline: Commodity prices rally as the dollar weakens
templates.explanation: Commodities are priced in dollars, so a weaker dollar makes them cost more.

templates.headline: Tariff fight hits chemical exporters
templates.explanation: Taxes on exports make US chemicals more expensive abroad, so sales drop.

templates.headline: AI data centres drive record power demand
templates.explanation: Data centres need huge amounts of electricity, so power companies can sell more.

templates.headline: Heatwave blackouts bring costly fines for power companies
templates.explanation: Fines and repairs come straight out of a utility's slow, steady profits.

templates.headline: Bond yields fall, lifting dividend stocks
templates.explanation: When bonds pay less, steady dividend payers like utilities look more attractive.

templates.headline: Regulators reject power price rises
templates.explanation: Utilities need permission to raise prices; without it, rising costs eat their profits.

templates.headline: Mortgage rates fall to a two-year low
templates.explanation: Cheaper borrowing makes property more valuable and helps landlords refinance.

templates.headline: Empty offices pile up as remote work sticks
templates.explanation: Empty buildings earn no rent, and their value drops.

templates.headline: Warehouse rents climb on e-commerce demand
templates.explanation: Online shops need warehouses near customers, so landlords can charge more.

templates.headline: Property prices fall for a sixth straight month
templates.explanation: Lower property values shrink what property companies own and can borrow against.

templates.headline: Tesla deliveries crush expectations
templates.explanation: Selling far more cars than forecast means more revenue than investors had priced in.

templates.headline: Tesla recalls two million cars over autopilot
templates.explanation: A recall costs money and raises doubts about the self-driving story investors pay for.

templates.headline: Meta ad revenue soars on AI targeting
templates.explanation: Better-targeted ads sell for more, and almost all of Meta's money comes from ads.

templates.headline: Meta fined billions over user data
templates.explanation: A huge fine is a direct hit to profits, and more rules may follow.

templates.headline: Judge rules Google search is an illegal monopoly
templates.explanation: Google may be forced to change or split its most profitable business.

templates.headline: Google's new AI model wows developers
templates.explanation: Investors feared AI would hurt Google search; a strong model calms that fear.

templates.headline: Eli Lilly weight-loss pill succeeds in trial
templates.explanation: A pill is easier to sell than an injection, so the market for the drug grows.

templates.headline: Eli Lilly slashes sales forecast on supply problems
templates.explanation: It can't make enough of its best-selling drugs, so less money comes in.

templates.headline: Boeing jet loses door panel mid-flight
templates.explanation: Safety scares lead to groundings, investigations and cancelled orders.

templates.headline: Boeing lands its biggest order in a decade
templates.explanation: A giant order means years of guaranteed revenue.

templates.headline: Moderna cancer vaccine shows stunning results
templates.explanation: Small biotech companies can double on one successful trial.

templates.headline: Moderna flu shot falls short in key study
templates.explanation: When a company has few products, one failed trial can halve its value.

templates.headline: Netflix adds far more subscribers than expected
templates.explanation: More subscribers means more monthly fees, beyond what investors expected.

templates.headline: Netflix loses subscribers for the first time in years
templates.explanation: Losing customers breaks the growth story the share price was built on.

templates.headline: AMD unveils AI chip that rivals NVIDIA's best
templates.explanation: A real rival product could win AMD a slice of the huge AI chip market.

templates.headline: Intel delays its next chip factory again
templates.explanation: Delays push back the turnaround investors are waiting for.

templates.headline: Exxon profits fall less than feared
templates.explanation: Prices move on surprises: 'less bad than expected' is good news.

templates.headline: Caterpillar warns mining customers are cutting back
templates.explanation: Fewer machine orders today means lower sales for months to come.
